sentences.en: Open the cupboard on the left. The bottles are there.
sentences.zh: 打开左边的那个碗橱，瓶子里装的就是。

sentences.en: A large cupboard stood in the corner of the room.
sentences.zh: 房间角落里放着一个大碗橱。

sentences.en: If you want tea, I have some in the cupboard.
sentences.zh: 如果你想喝茶，我碗橱里有一些。

senses.zh: 柜橱(在英式英语中,cupboard指所有类似的家具) ；食物柜，食橱
